<i>stacks/workload/releases.tfvars</i><br/><br/><b>Single Release Candidate Promotion</b><br/>• Exactly one RC promoted sequentially across tiers<br/>• Zero environment-specific artifact builds<br/>• Same byte-identical packages tested in dev, qa, pdn<br/><br/><b>Audit &amp; Traceability</b><br/>• Traceable to commit hash, roadmap issue, PR approval" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="345" (validate, tflint, checkov)<br/>• Zero high/critical security findings allowed<br/><br/><b>Execution &amp; Testing</b><br/>• Automated <i>terraform apply</i> via GitHub OIDC<br/>• Function deployment and test evidence<br/>• Gate 2: 1 peer review (SR1, SR2, JR1, JR2 not author, ASM-172)<br/>• Gate 3: <i>terraform plan</i> diff inspection<br/><br/><b>Execution &amp; Testing</b><br/>• Automated Plan Review: QA acceptance recorded, zero drift<br/><br/><b>Deployment &amp; Safeguards</b><br/>• Automated <i>terraform apply</i> via GitHub OIDC<br/>• CodeDeploy canary traffic shift (10% 5 min, style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Pipeline Identity & State [D01, D02, D03, D06]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="35" width="410" x="235" y="717" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>GitHub Actions OIDC Authentication (ADR-003)</b><br/>• Short-lived STS credentials via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials<br/>• Zero static AWS access keys or long-lived secrets in GitHub<br/><br/><b>Scoped Pipeline Roles (ASM-171, ADR-003)</b><br/>• <i>plan</i> role: Scoped read-only plan permissions for PR checks<br/>• <i>apply</i> role: Scoped write permissions for deployment on merge<br/>• BreakGlass permission set operates via AWS IAM, never deployment path<br/><br/><b>Remote State Isolation [D02]</b><br/>• Dedicated S3 state bucket per environment (dev, qa, pdn isolated)<br/>• Native state locking (DynamoDB lock table / S3 locking) prevents collision<br/>• Server-side encryption with KMS CMK (<i>state</i> key class, ASM-097)<br/><br/><b>Configuration &amp; Secrets [D03]</b><br/>• AWS Secrets Manager &amp; SSM Parameter Store for runtime credentials<br/>• Dynamic runtime resolution; zero credentials in git or state (ADR-003)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="335" width="560" x="85" y="765" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_b2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="600" x="695" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_codedeploy" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#C925D1;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;html=1;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.codedeploy;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="715" y="715" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_lambda_b2" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;html=1;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="765" y="715" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_b2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Function Deployment Pattern [D11]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="35" width="460" x="815" y="717" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>Deployment Engine &amp; Strategy (ASM-174)</b><br/>• AWS CodeDeploy application and deployment groups<br/>• dev: <i>CodeDeployDefault.LambdaAllAtOnce</i> for sandbox speed<br/>• qa &amp; pdn: <i>CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes</i><br/><br/><b>Traffic Shifting &amp; Validation</b><br/>• Routes 10% live traffic to new Lambda alias version for 5 minutes<br/>• Automated rollback triggered if any rollback alarm enters ALARM state<br/>• Shifts remaining 90% traffic to new version upon green bake window<br/>• Minimum 5 published Lambda versions kept alive (ASM-174)<br/><br/><b>Target Function Workloads (ASM-160, ASM-161, ASM-170)</b><br/>• Telemetry threshold function [D10] (evaluates reading vs DynamoDB)<br/>• Drone reception &amp; screening function [D06]<br/>• Bedrock inference functions [D10] (confirmation, verification, estimation)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="335" width="560" x="715" y="765" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_b3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="600" x="1325" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_cw_b3" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;html=1;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.cloudwatch_2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="1345" y="715" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_b3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Observability & Rollback Hooks [D13]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="35" width="510" x="1395" y="717" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>CloudWatch Rollback Alarm Hooks (ASM-174, A18 sec 12)</b><br/>• Lambda alias error rate alarms: <i>&lt;prefix&gt;-pdn-alarm-&lt;fn&gt;-errors</i><br/>• Lambda throttles alarms: <i>&lt;prefix&gt;-pdn-alarm-&lt;fn&gt;-throttles</i><br/>• Function DLQ message alarms: <i>infthresholddlq</i>, <i>infconfirmdlq</i><br/>• API Gateway 5XX alarms: <i>&lt;prefix&gt;-pdn-alarm-api-5xx</i><br/><br/><b>Rollback Design Targets (ASM-174, PD-176)</b><br/>• Automatic CodeDeploy rollback: Traffic back to prior version &lt; 10 min<br/>• Rollback deployment: Move alias to prior version &lt; 30 min of decision<br/>• Revert commit through promotion: Plan review &amp; apply &lt; 2 hours<br/><br/><b>Failure Recovery &amp; Redrive (A18 sec 10)</b><br/>• Dead-letter queue redrive executed by platform operator after rollback<br/>• Deployment events published to SNS release topic and GitHub status" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="335" width="560" x="1345" y="765" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_b4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="640" x="1955" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_b4" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Harvest Blackout & Incident Exception Policy" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="35" width="600" x="1975" y="717" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b4" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>Coffee Harvest Deployment Blackout (ASM-183)</b><br/>• Standard production deployments blocked during harvest weeks<br/>• Protects critical harvest intake operations across Cauca, Huila, Tolima<br/>• Advance Notice: Default 2 business days lead time to Federation (ASM-173)<br/><br/><b>Emergency Incident Exception (ASM-183)</b><br/>• Urgent change inside window or shortened notice requires incident declaration<br/>• Declared by one of SR1 or SR2 with formal incident reference<br/>• Incident reference recorded in approval and release note<br/>• Shortened notice sent at decision; completed note within 1 business day<br/><br/><b>Forward Correction &amp; Schema Compatibility (ASM-175, ASM-185)</b><br/>• Fixes roll forward through standard Git promotion (dev -> qa -> pdn)<br/>• Additive schema changes: readers ignore unrecognized attributes<br/>• Safe rollbacks: attributes added by new versions ignored by prior version" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="335" width="600" x="1975" y="765" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
aroma-pacifico-terraform-modules (Public)
• Reusable Terraform reference modules
• Published via semver tags (vX.Y.Z)
• Zero account IDs, ARNs, credentials or state
• Verified by tflint, validate, and checkov
aroma-pacifico-infrastructure (Private)
• Root stack definitions per environment (dev, qa, pdn)
• Consumes modules by tag; remote state per account
• Plan-only automation; zero live resource creation
aroma-pacifico-platform (Private, ASM-170)
• Application services, Lambda functions, prompts
• Code mapped to platform, ingestion, flight pipelines

div.div:
Deterministic Artifact Pinning (ASM-171)
• Built once per release tag by artifact publisher role
• Lambda zip packages and container images
• Staged to regional S3 artifact bucket per environment
• Digest pinned in stacks/workload/releases.tfvars
Single Release Candidate Promotion
• Exactly one RC promoted sequentially across tiers
• Zero environment-specific artifact builds
• Same byte-identical packages tested in dev, qa, pdn
Audit & Traceability
• Traceable to commit hash, roadmap issue, PR approval

Four Mandatory Production Gates

2. Federation Notice: 2 business days lead time (ASM-173, Q-15)
3. Harvest Window: Outside harvest blackout (ASM-183)
4. Plan Review: QA acceptance recorded, zero drift
Deployment & Safeguards
• Automated terraform apply via GitHub OIDC
• CodeDeploy canary traffic shift (10% 5 min, D11)
• CloudWatch rollback alarms armed (D13)

div.div:
GitHub Actions OIDC Authentication (ADR-003)
• Short-lived STS credentials via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials
• Zero static AWS access keys or long-lived secrets in GitHub
Scoped Pipeline Roles (ASM-171, ADR-003)
• plan role: Scoped read-only plan permissions for PR checks
• apply role: Scoped write permissions for deployment on merge
• BreakGlass permission set operates via AWS IAM, never deployment path
Remote State Isolation [D02]
• Dedicated S3 state bucket per environment (dev, qa, pdn isolated)
• Native state locking (DynamoDB lock table / S3 locking) prevents collision
• Server-side encryption with KMS CMK (state key class, ASM-097)
Configuration & Secrets [D03]
• AWS Secrets Manager & SSM Parameter Store for runtime credentials
• Dynamic runtime resolution; zero credentials in git or state (ADR-003)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 558px; height: 1px; padding-top: 752px; margin-left: 688px;

div.div:
Deployment Engine & Strategy (ASM-174)
• AWS CodeDeploy application and deployment groups
• dev: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaAllAtOnce for sandbox speed
• qa & pdn: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
Traffic Shifting & Validation
• Routes 10% live traffic to new Lambda alias version for 5 minutes
• Automated rollback triggered if any rollback alarm enters ALARM state
• Shifts remaining 90% traffic to new version upon green bake window
• Minimum 5 published Lambda versions kept alive (ASM-174)
Target Function Workloads (ASM-160, ASM-161, ASM-170)
• Telemetry threshold function [D10] (evaluates reading vs DynamoDB)
• Drone reception & screening function [D06]
• Bedrock inference functions [D10] (confirmation, verification, estimation)

div.div: Observability & Rollback Hooks [D13]

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 558px; height: 1px; padding-top: 752px; margin-left: 1318px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;

div.div:
CloudWatch Rollback Alarm Hooks (ASM-174, A18 sec 12)
• Lambda alias error rate alarms: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-<fn>-errors
• Lambda throttles alarms: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-<fn>-throttles
• Function DLQ message alarms: infthresholddlq, infconfirmdlq
• API Gateway 5XX alarms: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-api-5xx
Rollback Design Targets (ASM-174, PD-176)
• Automatic CodeDeploy rollback: Traffic back to prior version < 10 min
• Rollback deployment: Move alias to prior version < 30 min of decision
• Revert commit through promotion: Plan review & apply < 2 hours
Failure Recovery & Redrive (A18 sec 10)
• Dead-letter queue redrive executed by platform operator after rollback
• Deployment events published to SNS release topic and GitHub status

div.div: Harvest Blackout & Incident Exception Policy

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 598px; height: 1px; padding-top: 752px; margin-left: 1948px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;

div.div:
Coffee Harvest Deployment Blackout (ASM-183)
• Standard production deployments blocked during harvest weeks
• Protects critical harvest intake operations across Cauca, Huila, Tolima
• Advance Notice: Default 2 business days lead time to Federation (ASM-173)
Emergency Incident Exception (ASM-183)
• Urgent change inside window or shortened notice requires incident declaration
• Declared by one of SR1 or SR2 with formal incident reference
• Incident reference recorded in approval and release note
• Shortened notice sent at decision; completed note within 1 business day
Forward Correction & Schema Compatibility (ASM-175, ASM-185)
• Fixes roll forward through standard Git promotion (dev -> qa -> pdn)
• Additive schema changes: readers ignore unrecognized attributes
• Safe rollbacks: attributes added by new versions ignored by prior version
